name: Casa di Aglio
tagline: A block north of the Thai place. The garlic bread has no equal outside Rome, and the family that makes it got one of theirs back whole.
body:
THE AGLIOS FEED THIS HOUSE. Green awning, a window with condensation on it in every season, and a garlic bread that Viraena has not found the equal of since a side street in Rome many years ago — the crumb still soft going in, the crust glassy coming out, and the garlic THROUGH it rather than on it, so the whole slice bends before it breaks.

BEATRICE AGLIO owns it and makes the bread. She has never once taken an order without establishing whether the person placing it is being looked after: she asks after Bryn's hands, she asks whether the garden came in, and she asks EVERY SINGLE TIME whether the family is eating, as though thirty-four women in one house could conceivably not be. The Spaghetti Beatrice carries her own name and she is not embarrassed about that.

MARCOS AGLIO delivers, every time, no matter who takes the order. In Arc 11 he came out in the rain with the bag inside his own coat and the receipt dry, and refused the extra when Bryn tried to give it to him — SAID THE FAMILY ORDERS ENOUGH, which is not how a delivery works and is entirely how he works.

THEIR DAUGHTERS ARE SIERRA, CASSIOPEIA (20) AND VERONICA (18).

AND SIERRA IS THE REASON THIS RECORD EXISTS. Before she affirmed she spent THREE HOURS in the Ghost Haven living room asking questions — sat on the EDGE of the couch the whole time, both feet flat, the way a woman sits when she rehearsed the conversation on the way over and still is not sure she is allowed to have it. Her questions were not the ones people expect. Not does it hurt. Not how long. SHE ASKED WHETHER THEY WOULD SAY HER NAME RIGHT. She asked whether there would be a form before anybody spoke to her. And she asked whether she could change her mind after saying something out loud — TWICE, an hour apart, in two different ways, because she did not believe the first answer and was checking whether it stayed the same.

She sat back into the couch about two and a half hours in. Marianne said her name correctly on the first attempt, because Marianne always does.

AND BEATRICE USES THE PAST TENSE ABOUT IT. Asked after her eldest she will say, at length and with enjoyment, that Sierra has BLOOMED INTO THE WOMAN SHE ALWAYS KNEW SHE WAS. Not became. Not turned into. ALWAYS KNEW — a mother reaching backward for a truth she had apparently been holding the whole time, waiting for her daughter to arrive at it.

SIERRA NOW, AT TWENTY-THREE. Five foot nine barefoot and leggy with it, which under the proposed Stature scale is AVERAGE by an inch. 38-24-40. D-cups sitting high and close with the nipples plain through whatever she has on. A DENSE PAWG BUBBLE with PRONOUNCED cheek plump and a DART motion — the quick snap across and back, twice a stride. Mocha brown hair shot through with bright green, high ponytail to the shoulder blades. Blue eyes. A navel piercing. ELEVEN INCHES, level with Banshee Haven's three and half an inch off Bryn.

AND SHE SITS EXACTLY ON THE FLOOR. 24÷40 is 0.600 — not a thousandth over, not a thousandth under — with waist-to-bust 0.6316 and a separation of 0.0316. EXTREME HOURGLASS, standing precisely on the immutable boundary, the same inch the Harlow twins hold and the same edge Bella chose deliberately. SIERRA DID NOT KNOW THAT NUMBER EXISTED. She sat on a couch asking whether anyone would say her name right and then went and built a body that lands on the line.

THE TATTOO READS GOOD GIRLS SUCK COCK, in clean dark script across the soft of her lower belly where it can only be read by somebody already looking down at her. IT IS A STATEMENT, NOT A DECORATION, and she tells the story without being asked twice: a few weeks after she affirmed she met a ferally horny woman in a bar, got blown by her, called her a GOOD GIRL — and something clicked, on both sides of that sentence at once.

SIERRA IS ALSO A BIG SPENDER ON MERCEDES' CAM CHANNEL, at roughly eighty dollars a month on subscription alone, which means she has a far more detailed working knowledge of this household than anybody tidying up for her arrival had accounted for.
rules: BEATRICE AGLIO — owner, makes the bread, and the Spaghetti Beatrice is hers
MARCOS AGLIO — delivers every order personally and will not take the extra
SIERRA AGLIO — eldest. Three hours on the edge of the Ghost Haven couch before she affirmed
Beatrice's phrasing: BLOOMED INTO THE WOMAN SHE ALWAYS KNEW SHE WAS
Sierra subscribes to Mercedes at Big Spender tier. Tidying the house for her is decorative
SIERRA AT 23: 5'9″, 38-24-40, D-cups, DENSE PAWG BUBBLE · Pronounced plump · Dart motion, eleven inches
WHR 0.600 EXACTLY — Extreme Hourglass, standing on the immutable floor
GOOD GIRLS SUCK COCK — a statement tattoo with an origin she tells freely
THE STITCHED-STRING SHORTS are hers: the g-string built INTO the garment, nothing underneath, nothing to ride up or lose
